quote: one straight lane per branch via interval coloring (lowest free lane, freed when the branch's visible life ends)
why: This decision rebuilt Trail as a git-graph timeline and established the algorithm for deriving lanes from branch intervals without authored graph edges.

quote: scope the worktree to the SESSION (not the task) and let branches own tasks
why: This decision explicitly established the worktree-to-session and branch-to-task binding and the agent-namespaced naming scheme.
